list: The official 55 trophies, as listed before this guide was written
source_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are this guide's own words, built from the official descriptions; anything not pinned down by a description is marked as our own reading, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then contacts and activities, then collectibles and cleanup — and the platinum is the last stop, not a grind of its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you start the game; nothing to prepare and nothing you can miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Main-story progress only: keep playing the missions in order and it unlocks when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Main-story progress only, same as the other chapter trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Main-story progress only.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Main-story progress only.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. It comes after Chapter 4, so it is one of the last story trophies. Keep a manual save before the finale if you want to revisit the ending afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Follow the mission markers and finish it; as a story mission it cannot be missed by playing the story through.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission: play it through to the end and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Story progress only.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story progress only.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Story progress only — the mission name says where it happens: the Vice City airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story progress only.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long one: story, side missions, activities and collectibles all feed the percentage. Use the in-game stats to find what is still missing, and treat it as the last trophy before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts build up across normal driving — jumps, near misses and air time — so chase them whenever you are between missions instead of grinding them all at once. The count is tracked by the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample everything: shooting range, races, fishing, arcade, meditation and the rest. You only need to try each once, not master it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the range's challenges one at a time and replay the ones you only passed until the gold medal lands; the range tracks your medals, so you can see which are left.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Visit each drone-race location and win there; a location you have not won at yet is one still on the list.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter different races across the state rather than replaying one favourite — only distinct wins count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. It is flagged missable because it is tied to a specific challenge: take it when it is offered rather than assuming it will wait.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade game and play it to the end; one finished game is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's mission strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Take on stranger missions whenever their markers appear and follow each strand to its end; eight finished strands is the mark.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Find the meditation spots as you explore and sit at each; a spot you have used is one ticked off, so sweep the map region by region.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a one-off: take it when it is offered and follow the hunt through. Flagged missable because a unique animal, once gone, may not come back.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Gather cards across Leonida and finish three full sets; hunt down the last cards of a set rather than opening packs at random.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at a hundred different spots — it is a volume hunt, so fold it into exploring rather than grinding it in one sitting.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges stack up across everything you do; fifty finished is the mark, and the game's challenge list shows which are closest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and get clear. Flagged missable because it needs your partner present — do it while the story keeps you together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner and keep the wanted level you already have — don't gain stars and don't lose the tail. Needs your partner, so it is flagged missable.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive everything you find: new models count when you first get in, so keep swapping rides instead of sticking to one favourite.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. It is one use, so pick a busy fight rather than a quiet one.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport in a way that is not on the schedule — our reading, from the description alone: take off or slip out without following the normal departure. The exact trigger is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description is a joke about Rhino tanks. Our reading: get mixed up with a Rhino tank and come out of it alive. The exact trigger is not yet checked in the game — try it in free roam once tanks are in play.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Plan the approach and leave clean — being seen fails it, so take the stealthy route.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five vaults and get away clean each time; escaping is part of the trophy, so plan the getaway before the grab.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road and get away afterwards — the escape counts, so have a fast car and a route in mind.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the state. The map fills in as you go, so sweep the regions you have not been to and the last few areas are the ones to hunt.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Hit one operation per gang — nine gangs, nine robberies. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit so none is left.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Our reading, from the description alone: find a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and order a drink with the view. The exact venue is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Our reading: take a car through a showroom's frontage rather than the door. The exact showroom is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and see the shot through. The venue is named in the description, so it is findable — the exact moment to go is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Our reading: a moment with your partner that draws a crowd. The exact trigger is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count of 500. Our reading: keep making choices — dialogue and mission choices — across the whole game, and the count climbs as you play.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Our reading: fail something, then clear it on the second try. If you fail a mission or challenge, retry it straight away — the second attempt is the one that counts.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Our reading: a strange, possibly random world event. Keep your eyes open in free roam; the exact trigger is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Our reading: while driving, knock someone down with a melee attack from the vehicle. The name is a bowling joke, and the exact input is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until a quarter of a million is clean; it stacks across the game, so keep feeding bills through as you earn them.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend a hundred thousand in the shops — cars, clothes, weapons, whatever you like. It counts across every shop, so it climbs while you play normally.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market; eight owned is the mark, and they give you somewhere to keep the vehicles from Whip It Good.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Put ten vehicles on the Scooter Bros app — drive a car, register it, and repeat until ten are listed.
